recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile portrait browser game called **World Circuit Rivals** from this steering prompt: Street Fighter versus fighting. A Street Fighter versus fighting game with iconic rivalries, tight combo timing, expressive character archetypes, global tournament intensity, readable special moves, and pure arcade duel drama with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

Recreate it as a roster-based two-corner auto fighting tournament. Players tap plus/minus cards to draft archetypal fighters for Corner A and Corner B, adjust durability, press FIGHT, then watch side-view AI fighters advance, collide, use cooldown specials, fire projectiles, trigger cinematic supers, and resolve by HP depletion. Preserve the original mechanics, cap, HP scaling, team HP HUD, pause, restart, and win/draw states while replacing the world with arcade duel drama, readable move callouts, authored ring/crowd visuals, procedural fighter silhouettes, and mobile-safe controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile portrait roster-based auto arena fighting simulator.
- objective: Choose units for two sides up to the same 15-fighter cap, set durability, start the round, and watch the side-view duel resolve until one non-summon team is eliminated.
- input model: Tap plus/minus roster controls, range slider for HP multiplier, start/pause/audio/menu/restart buttons; combat itself is AI-driven.
- core loop: Build Corner A and Corner B rosters, spawn both teams on opposite sides, AI units move toward nearest opponents, attack, use special skills, update team HP bars, declare draw/side win when primary fighters are gone.
- fail/friction state: Start is disabled if either side has no units; roster additions are blocked at 15; combat ends with Challenger win, Rival win, or double KO.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve two-team roster selection, 15-unit cap per side, plus/minus tapping, default one boss per side, HP multiplier values, AI movement, attack cooldowns, projectile/contact checks, special/super timing, HP aggregation, pause/restart/menu flow, and win/draw semantics.

## Remixed target
World Circuit Rivals reframes the same auto-duel mechanics as a Street Fighter-inspired global tournament: archetype move cards, rival corners, readable special moves, dramatic supers, mobile portrait HUD, and authored arcade stage art without changing the underlying round rules.
